oneLine: A browser replacement for a Kohler DTV+ shower's disconnected K-99693 wall interface, driving the controller's undocumented HTTP/0.9 CGI API through a raw-socket Node proxy behind a code-enforced safety gate, plus an open investigation into why the shower stops itself mid-use.
gate: The project's three most valuable artifacts are all outside git — 1,998 lines of single-copy hardware evidence in a gitignored trace, and the 2026-08-29 analysis of it untracked for 63 days — so the first action is preservation, not code, and the GPS bytes the 2026-10-08 commit stripped from the working tree are still live in public history awaiting an owner decision.

reusable.name: Raw-socket HTTP/0.9 client with a serialised queue

reusable.what: React screens styled after the wall interface, dark and light themes, rebuilt fitting icons
suits: replacing a dead appliance touchscreen with a phone

traps: seam — state DIFF trace lines: trace.mjs names the kind in comments (`:42`, `:131`) and nothing emits them. Reading 'DIFF' in the format header as a working feature is the mistake.
seam — phone-readable log viewer: middleware.mjs:125-173 has four /api/ routes and none serves the trace file, although the observability brief sequences it as step 5.

seam — Android/Capacitor host: the only artifact is the base-URL seam in app/src/api/config.ts. HTTP/0.9 means a Node proxy has to ship on every platform, so the mg-controller Capacitor config alone is not enough.
claimed — `num_interface = 0` as the live state: README.md:18-19, DESIGN.md:11-13 and PROTOCOL.md:199-201 still present it, and INVESTIGATIONS.md:518 has recorded `= 1` since 2026-08-04.
claimed — 'no valve has been opened by this app yet' (DESIGN.md:204-206): app/.trace/egress.log:1361 records quick_shower.cgi returning ':)' on 2026-08-11.
claimed — test counts in prose: DESIGN.md:165 says 49 (85 measured today) and viewer/README.md:87 says 88 (164 measured today). Cite the command, never the number.
claimed — STORY-LOG.md is 'newest first' per README.md:40: the 2026-10-08 commit made it oldest-first and rewrote AGENT.md:64-65 accordingly.
claimed — 'one bad read in 30-50' (research/FIELD-NOTES.md:251): the file labels it rough and INVESTIGATIONS.md I3 supersedes the mechanism, but the figure is still there and still cited.
claimed — DTV_TRACE=0 as a kill switch (trace.mjs:71): setting it fails 12 of 85 tests, measured today.
claimed — steam, lighting, rain panel and the second valve (DESIGN.md:207-214): coded against the controller's own JS, none installed on this system, never exercised.
claimed — the view gizmo being 'on a path into Maker Galaxy': mg-web/src contains no viewGizmo, gizmoDrag or cameraTween, and neither repo has moved in 89 days.

trap — no server-side temperature clamp: the proxy forwards params unclamped and the clamp is UI-only. The controller is also reachable unauthenticated by any LAN client, so a proxy clamp would protect less than it appears to.

trap — npm test writes a NOTE line into app/.trace/egress.log via vite.config.ts evaluating the middleware at config time. Redirect DTV_TRACE_DIR before running the suite or the evidence file gains events that never happened.

trap — licence: research/xagon0 states no licence upstream, research/reference and viewer/public/models hold Kohler copyright material whose redistribution PROVENANCE.md says 'needs a deliberate call' that was never made, and LICENSE.md:46 reads 'Status: Draft'. Treat everything under those three paths as unlicensed for reuse.
trap — cnc/ has no README and nothing records which of the two rear-cover revisions is installed in the wall.
trap — polling floor: 15 s idle and 5 s active is a hard floor recorded in research/FIELD-NOTES.md, not a tuning parameter. Raising it risks a lockup measured in hours.
licence: Maker Galaxy AGPL for Makers v1 (Draft), vendored from e:/git/OpenMakerLicense; scope table in LICENSE.md. Does not cover research/xagon0 (no upstream licence), research/reference or viewer/public/models (Kohler copyright).

onFire.item: The only copy of the project's newest hardware evidence, and the only analysis of it, are both outside git
onFire.evidence: app/.trace/egress.log is 1,998 lines, gitignored (app/.gitignore:11-13), mtime 2026-08-29, and the app has not run since 2026-08-11. git status has shown the same four untracked paths for 63 days: docs/state/2026-08-29-KOHLER-DTV-PLUS-STATE-OF-PROJECT.md and three files under research/scout/. research/diagnostics/ holds four files, newest 2026-08-04.
onFire.action: Copy the 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-11 windows of app/.trace/egress.log into research/diagnostics/ with dates in the filenames, then git add the four untracked paths and commit. No decision required.

onFire.item: GPS coordinates of the owner's premises are still in the public git history
onFire.evidence: git show 5d83023^:Images/KohlerBoardOverall.webp still contains an exif:GPS chunk; the introducing commit 05ebb49 (2026-07-26) is an ancestor of origin/master; HEAD equals origin/master. The 2026-10-08 commit body states the old bytes remain on the remote pending an owner decision, which is tracked as storylog backlog row S20 and not in this repo.
onFire.action: Owner decision: purge the blob from history and force-push (accepting that forks and host caches are not reached), or record in this repo that the exposure is accepted and why. Either way append the story-log entry AGENT.md:58 requires.
